children: INTENDS TO LIST COMPANY'S SHARES ON NASDAQ FIRST NORTH GROWTH MARKET AND PUBLISHES COMPANY DESCRIPTION
IN CONNECTION WITH THE LISTING, THE COMPANY INTENDS TO CARRY OUT AN OFFERING TO THE GENERAL PUBLIC IN SWEDEN OF SEK 27.5 MILLION
PRICE PER SHARE IN OFFERING SEK 55 PER SHARE, CORRESPONDS TO MARKET VALUE OF SEK 1,158 MILLION FOR OUTSTANDING SHARES BEFORE OFFERING
FIRST DAY OF TRADING IN THE COMPANY'S SHARES ON NASDAQ FIRST NORTH GROWTH MARKET IS EXPECTED TO BE SEPTEMBER 21, 2026
